desc:
Note: This game contains Jump scares!

Budget cuts have been made at Roblox High and Teachers have been replaced with Robots. A new prototype called Ani-Tron is now in charge of Detention Class. 

Apparently these robots are reliable but they get a little Glitchy if students misbehave.

So you have been sent to after school Detention and Miss Ani-Tron wont take kindly to people who try to escape!
Anyone who tries to escape will make Ani-Tron ANGRY! 

Can you Escape out of school and avoid the animatronic Robots to freedom?

Please leave a Like and Favourite this game. It helps a lot :)

Escape Miss Ani-Tron's Detention! (SCARY OBBY) Created by:
FatPapsGamesLtd
